title: Only a Little to the Left: A Theory-grounded Measure of Political Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with political statements from the World Values Survey and the Political Compass Test using 30 prompt variations (including different prefixes, rephrasings, and open vs. closed settings), and applying a fine-tuned automatic stance classifier to evaluate agreement or disagreement in the models' free-text responses to compute a left-right ideological leaning.
